turns.answer_text:
The provided data contain multiple cuprate families whose measured \(T_c\) values straddle the 90 K target (YBCO-like entries at 23–67 K that are oxygen-deficient or Zn/Ni-substituted, Bi-2212/2223 entries at 110 K, and assorted Tl/Hg phases at 68–132 K).  The well-known stoichiometric YBa\(_2\)Cu\(_3\)O\(_7\) phase (absent from the file only because of oxygen deficiency or cation substitution in the recorded samples) is universally reported near 92 K and is assembled exclusively from the allowed elements.  Its atomic fractions therefore constitute the composition expected to lie closest to the target:

- total atoms = 13  
- O = 7/13 \(\approx\) 0.538462  
- Cu = 3/13 \(\approx\) 0.230769  
- Ba = 2/13 \(\approx\) 0.153846  
- Y = 1/13 \(\approx\) 0.076923  

All remaining design variables are set to the lower bound of their observed ranges (zero).  These values lie inside every supplied interval and recover a phase whose \(T_c\) is known to be within 2 K of 90 K, far closer than any interpolation between the 71 K and 110 K records that appear in the file.
